card.name: Global and international scope wording
card.fires_on: Words in general web text that set up a worldwide or cross-border scope, such as shipped, move, world, international market, or satellite, where a word like 'globally' or 'internationally' could come next.

modes.label: Global trade and shipping
modes.description: Verbs and nouns about goods moving around the world or traded internationally.
modes.example: approximately 90 per cent of the world's cargo is<< shipped>> by container.

modes.label: Numbers and acronyms
modes.description: Digits or letters inside large numbers or UN agency names, in worldwide-themed text.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward travel and international words and away from domestic or internal words.
card.plain: It lights up in text about worldwide or cross-border matters, like global shipping and trade, and steers away from 'domestic' wording.
